newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia FACB plans 3 bln rgt projects.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia FACB plans 3 bln rgt projects.

text.p: Malaysian property and construction concern FACB Bhd said on Wednesday it has projects totalling nearly 3.0 billion ringgit in hand which will be carried out over the next five years.
Company president and chief executive officer Chen Lip Keong said one of the projects is a 1.65 billion ringgit township which has received in-principle approval from the government.

The 551.2 hectare project in central Selangor state is projected to contribute a pretax profit of 500 million ringgit when completed in five years, he told reporters after the company's annual meeting.
Chen said FACB would also invest 1.05 billion ringgit in a resort in eastern Sabah state over the next three years.
The investment would include the building of four hotels, the first of which would open for business in mid-1997.
FACB had spent 440 million ringgit on land and infrastructure costs and expects spend another 610 million to complete the other three hotels by 1999.
Chen also said FACB plans to start its own hotel chain called Nexus International Hotels which would manage nine hotels with a combined total of 3,000 rooms by 1999.
The hotels are the four in Sabah, three in Cambodia and two in Kuala Lumpur.
